title: Standardize layer constraints and slim variant strategy for charts & controls
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Our Figma library has accumulated chart and control components with inconsistent layer constraints, duplicate visual states, and bloated variant sets (multiple near-identical variants for hover/focused/disabled). This causes design drift, developer confusion, and increases the risk of regressions when publishing.

Goal: Reduce the variant surface area by establishing a slim-variant pattern, standardize layer constraints and layer naming for responsive chart components (legend, axis labels, tooltips), and publish a gated library update with a migration guide and automated rename script.

Scope: 80+ chart and control components across tables, sparkline, bar/line charts, filter chips, and button groups. Changes are limited to structural rework in the Figma library files and an optional mapping CSV for engineering to consume. No token value changes in this ticket (that will be a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Create a single source-of-truth constraint guideline file in the UI kit (FigJam + Confluence link) explaining 'Pin to edge' and 'Scale' usage for chart sublayers
Reduce visible variants for target components to a maximum of 4 canonical states (default, hover, pressed, disabled) unless accessibility needs require otherwise
All renamed layers follow the pattern: <component>-<part>-<state>-<tokenRef> and are applied consistently across updated components
Publish gated library update with canary enabled; 10% of product teams subscribed to the kit should receive the update first
Migration CSV (old_name -> new_name) exported and placed in the repo; engineering sign-off on mappings recorded in PR
tasks: Audit: run component inventory and tag components with 'constraint-issue' (https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/UI-Kit)
Design: draft layer naming and constraint guidelines in FigJam (link in comments)
Implement: update chart components to use newly standardized auto-layout constraints and remove duplicate variants
Script: export mapping CSV via Figma plugin (figma-plugin-scripter) and validate against live instances
Review: run internal design review + 1 engineering review for token/backwards compatibility
Publish: create canary library release and coordinate with two product teams for smoke tests
Audit post-publish: run automated diff and hand-check top 10 impacted screens
